paragraphs.text: Syr Elenora , the Discerning , is a human knight of Eldraine .

Syr Elenora is a knight of Vantress . While not much is known about her background, it is known that the knights of Vantress are devoted to seeking out knowledge. Before becoming a knight, one must tell the Magic Mirror a secret that it does not already know, and even then, the gift of knighthood is bestowed at the Mirror's inscrutable discretion. Once one recieves the gift of knighthood Vantress knights will continue to seek out new secrets for the Mirror alongside putting their knowledge in to use by venturing out into the world and the wilds. Many Vantress knights strive to help those who are in need of knowledge. When someone is stumped by a faerie 's riddle, can't bypass an enchanted door, or is enthralled by witchcraft, a knight of Vantress might arrive to help them out of their predicament.
